title: EvoStar 2027
about: EvoStar 2027, the European event on bio-inspired AI covering EuroGP, EvoApplications, EvoCOP, EvoMUSART and the new EvoLearn track, takes place 31 March to 2 April 2027 in Mainz in hybrid mode. Papers are reviewed double-blind.

upskill.name: AI Foundations
why: No catalog course reaches course_min_score (best 4.7) and none has an objective on evolutionary or bio-inspired methods; "Bio-inspired AI and evolutionary computation" → closest Academy page: AI Foundations (core AI methods, incl. "Classical search: A*, heuristic search, constraint propagation" in A001.13)
